newsitem.title: DUBAI: Abu Dhabi to increase gas handling capacity.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi to increase gas handling capacity.

text.p: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) will increase capacity at its main Habshan onshore gas treatment plant to keep pace with an expected doubling of local gas demand, the firm said in its monthly magazine Adnoc News.
The Habshan natural gas plant will be expanded to handle three billion cubic feet a day (Bcfd) from its current capacity of nearly two Bcfd by 1999, the company said.
Analysts forecast that Abu Dhabi gas demand will reach more than 3 billion cubic feet a day (Bcfd) by 1999 from current demand of 1.8 Bcfd.
Habshan handles gas from the Thamama reserves at the onshore Bab field and supplies domestic electricity and water utilities, industrial plants and oil and petrochemical refineries.
Abu Dhabi is the main oil-producing emirate of OPEC member United Arab Emirates (UAE), pumping some 1.8 million barrels per day (bpd) of crude.
